decisions.reason: As a close-to-core device that stayed on its own webpage across 2023 and 2024 in a growing market, it still looks like a low-cost option worth retaining.

Because it is distant from the firm’s established medical-technology system offer, the strategic fit and option value look weaker relative to other projects, so resources are more likely to be reallocated.

Although still new and only lightly featured in 2024, it is close to the firm’s digital production workflow and certification-based capabilities, so the firm is likely to keep it while uncertainty resolves.
